title: Ball-milled zinc nickel sulfide nanostructures on nickel substrate for enhanced electrochemical methanol sensing
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30715-30730
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02062C, Paper

N. Roushdy, Mervet Ramadan, Samah. M. Yousef, A. A. M. Farag, Amany S. El-Khouly, M. Y. Nassar, Rasha Abu-Khudir, M. S. Ayoup, Mohamed S. Elnouby, Elbadawy A. Kamoun
Zinc-nickel sulfide nanostructures were synthesized via a simple ball-milling process followed by low-temperature annealing and investigated exclusively as a surface-modifying layer for electrochemical methanol sensing on conductive substrates.
